Winterspell Lore Card (1 of 9)
products.text:
Dear Martin,
Hi, friend. I'm just checking in to make sure everything is okay. The snowstorm hit the Great Illuminary hard, and I'm stuck until a thaw comes—if one comes at all. Do you have any idea what happened? I hope you get this. Archimedes promised he'd deliver it, but it's pretty cold out there, even for a glimmer.
Yours,
Venturo

products.name: Winterspell Lore Card (2 of 9)
products.text:
Hey Venturo,
Am I okay? I'm more than okay, I'm having a BLAST! A huge snowball fight broke out in the town square and it seems like every glimmer in Lorcana is part of the action. Stitch got his tongue stuck to a window and was pelted with snowballs. Any word from Shanzay? I haven't seen her since the storm hit.
"Warmly,"
Martin

products.name: Winterspell Lore Card (3 of 9)
products.text:
Shanzay,
I hope Tinker Bell gets this message to you. She seemed confident that she could. If I don't hear from your soon, I'm going to organize a glimmer rescue party. This snow is no joke!
Your hero,
Martin
P.S. You gotta try Mrs. Cratchit's pudding. It's plum-azing!

products.name: Winterspell Lore Card (4 of 9)
products.text:
Hi Martin,
I got lost in the blizzard, but Tink found me and we took refuge in a cave. I made it back to the Beast's castle to warm up with her and the other glimmers there before heading back out. Plum pudding, you say? I'll be right there!
—Shanzay

products.name: Winterspell Lore Card (5 of 9)
products.text:
Dear Shanzay,
I'm worried. I think my Elsa glimmer is missing. I've also noticed a strange phenomenon. All the icicles in the trees seem to point in the same horizontal direction. I wonder if they point toward the same thing. Can you go investigate?
Be Safe,
Venturo

products.name: Winterspell Lore Card (6 of 9)
products.text:
Dear Venturo,
Get this! The icicles look like they point in the same direction, but they actually all point AWAY from a specific location. My Anna glimmer and I checked it out and found an enormous frozen vine there. And when she heard Elsa was missing, Anna took off to find her before I could do anything. You're still in the Illuminary, right? She's heading your way now.
—Shanzay

products.name: Winterspell Lore Card (7 of 9)
products.text:
Dear Shanzay,
I left the Illuminary. I would have stayed, but it got so strangely cold all of the sudden—colder than when the storm first hit. I'm enjoying a bowl of Mrs. Cratchit's soup at the moment. (You need to try it!) Before I left, I saw that Anna had arrived to look for Elsa. I hope she finds her...
Best,
Venturo

products.name: Winterspell Lore Card (8 of 9)
products.text:
Shanzay,
Venturo told me about the frozen vine and how it might have a connection to this winter storm. Between snowball battles, I've been asking around to see if anyone knows where it came from. Did someone inkcast it? Do you recognize it? There are a lot of rumors going around about where the storm came from, but it seems clear that the vine is at the center of all this.
Quizzically,
Martin

products.name: Winterspell Lore Card (9 of 9)
products.text:
Martin,
You may be right about the vine. I heard back from Anna at the Illuminary. She discovered that Elsa had sealed herself away there, fearful of her own power. Could Elsa have played a role in this sudden magical storm? Did she try to freeze the vine? If she did, why? And what happened that made her so afraid? I have so many questions. Most importantly, did you save me some pudding?
Hungrily,
Shanzay

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (Set of 18)
Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (1 of 18)
products.text:
DET. WILDE: "Well, I don't understand why you have to interview me, Carrots."
DET. HOPPS: "We have to interview everyone."
WILDE: "Aren't we working this case together? You know what I know.
HOPPS: "I've still got to write it all down, Nick. A good detective documents everything."
Transcript of an assignment debrief with glimmer Detective Nick Wilde

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (2 of 18)
products.text:
ROO: "I'm tired of all these questions, Mama. I wanna go home."
KANGA: "Don't worry, dear. We'll be back to our lorebook in no time."
ROO: "How do you know, Mama?"
KANGA: "Because we have Detective Wilde and everyone helping us. We just have to be brave."
Transcript of an interview with Kanga and Roo whispers

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (3 of 18)
products.text:
"Say, friend, could you help a Genie out? I seem to have become separated from my iiitty-bitty lorebook. Bottles, lamps, books—you'd think a being of phenomenal cosmic powers would get tired of such small spaces after centuries. But I did like that lorebook."
Transcript of an interview with a Genie whisper

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (4 of 18)
products.text:
DET. GOOFY: "Gawrsh, is this thing on?"
DET. WILDE: "Yes, Detective. Now, your report. Please."
GOOFY: "Well, there I was, minding my business, when my sandwich turned into a smiling pink cat!"
WILDE: "A... pink cat?"
GOOFY: "Ayup. Oh golly, it's that one, right there on your shoulder!"
Transcript of an interview with glimmer Detective Goofy

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (5 of 18)
products.text:
DET. HOPPS: "So... Manny? Is that right?"
MANHORSE: (clop, clop, clop, clop)
HOPPS: "I see. I'm told you experienced a shock down in the Inkwell Caverns. Could you relate your story?"
MANHORSE: (clop, clop, clop-clop, clop)
HOPPS: "All right. Hey, Gearloose, do we have a headshot on file?"
Transcript of an interview with a Headless Manhorse glimmer

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (6 of 18)
products.text:
"Be careful. I walked down one of these staircases once and came right back up on account of all the strange noises. It doesn't look like anyone's been down here in ages—and there's no telling what might be lurking below the main floors..."
Transcript of an interview with Illumineer Venturo

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (7 of 18)
products.text:
DET. HOPPS: "I imagine you're used to strange things, as a wizard. Perhaps you could explain your current... situation, being so see-through and surrounded by these colorful wisps?"
MERLIN: "Well, it appears I am composed of incomplete materials. There's not enough substance for essence, and not enough essence for substance—you understand. Fiendish inconvenience, really."
Transcript of an interview with a Merlin whisper

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (8 of 18)
products.text:
"We recovered a key hidden inside a book in the lost study. Further investigation revealed it opens a secret passageway leading deep into the Illuminary, beneath the Inkworks. I thought about following the passageway to see where it goes, but I could use backup on this one. I'll get Nick first."
Case files of glimmer Detective Judy Hopps

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (9 of 18)
products.text:
"Second day of comparing the damaged lorebook pages we've recovered to the whispers who have come to us for help. Even with the entire Illuminary pitching in, it's slow going—but we won't give up!"
Case files of glimmer Detective Judy Hopps

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (10 of 18)
products.text:
"Cross-checking is done—for the whispers that want our help, anyway. Now we're facing the heart of the mystery: Who tore all those lorebook pages? And more importantly, how do we restore these whispers back to their original glimmer form?"
Case files of glimmer Detective Judy Hopps

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (11 of 18)
products.text:
"We discovered an ancient journal that seems to contain records of the glimmers on the torn pages. Nobody in the Illuminary knows who the book might have belonged to. Nick thinks the author lost their mind before completing it. In any case, the records are too damaged to tell us much."
Case files of glimmer Detective Judy Hopps

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (12 of 18)
products.text:
"Ran into a Fairy Godmother whisper who seemed much less bibbidi-bobbidi and a lot more boo. She told me, 'I'd fix this up with a bit of magic, but I seem to be missing some of my abilities...I'm afraid I can't be of much help at all.'"
Case files of glimmer Detective Judy Hopps

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (13 of 18)
products.text:
"Something weird is going on here. I don't know how to describe what I saw! It was a glimmer of a woman, but so colorful and not...right. She was trying to pick up a scrap of paper, but couldn't—like she wasn't all there. If that makes any sense."
Witness statement from a Daisy Duck glimmer

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (14 of 18)
products.text:
"Staked out the park for unusual litter-related activity yesterday, observing from a well-concealed position. Saw a ladybug. Really starting to like this whole detective thing. Oh, and nothing unusual to report. Maybe I blended in too well. Command, please advise on any disguise improvements."
Investigative report filed by glimmer Officer Higgins, detective trainee

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (15 of 18)
products.text:
"Lab is clear of evidence connecting Xanatos to the whispers. Recovered plenty of weapons and gear that looks like it could be used to explore the caverns. I recommend we continue keeping tabs. If there's one thing I know about Xanatos, it's that he's up to no good—even if we can't prove it yet."
Investigative report filed by glimmer Detective Elisa Maza

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (16 of 18)
products.text:
"Something is amiss on the lower floors of the Great Illuminary. Strange apparitions are about–whether conjured or inkcast, I cannot say. What I do know is that I intend to get to the bottom of this. Inform me at once if you discover anything of use in that ancient study."
Personal correspondence from glimmer Detective Basil to glimmer Dr. Dawson, special consultant

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (17 of 18)
products.text:
Agenda
1. Discuss the torn lorebook pages with Officer Hopps (Who likes to destroy lorebooks?)
2. Bring a dozen donuts for the office. (Sprinkles or glazed?)
Personal calendar of glimmer Officer Clawhauser, ZPD

products.name: Whispers in the Well Case File Cards (18 of 18)
products.text:
DET. WILDE: "Flash, buddy—we need your best effort on this one."
FLASH: "I'm... working... on... it."
WILDE: "Yeah, well, these whispers can't get back to their lorebooks, and we're their only chance of fixing that! Look, Judy needs this done soon."
FLASH: "I... will... get it... to... Judy... ASAP."
Transcript of a ZPD investigative strategy meeting

I've Waited Here Ages Now,

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Cards (Set of 19)
Reign of Jafar Lore Card (1 of 19)
products.text:
BE IT KNOWN
HIGH SULTAN JAFAR, LORD OF LORCANA, 
HEREBY PROCLAIMS HIS BENEVOLENT 
RULE FROM HIS SEAT OF POWER ON 
HEXWELL ISLAND! ALL ARE SUMMONED 
TO HIS MAGNIFICENT PALACE TO WITNESS 
HIS CORONATION. COME! BOW BEFORE 
HIM AND PAY TRIBUTE!

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (2 of 19)
products.text: Have you looked outside?" Martin said, peering out the window of Archazia's library. Venturo and Shanzay joined him and gasped. "Is that a wave... of sand?" Martin pointed to something sweeping across the tranquil forests of Hexwell Island. As it passed, trees twisted and cracked, and the landscape transformed. "Get Archazia. Hurry!" Shanzay told Martin, unable to take her eyes off the magical wave of sand. He dashed off.

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (3 of 19)
products.text:
While waiting for Martin to return with Archazia, Shanzay and Venturo watched as the island was overtaken by forceful magic and remade into something dry and barren with marble-and-gold buildings of garish opulence. 
"This is so wrong," said Shanzay. 
Moments later, Martin returned, breathless and clutching Archazia's inkcaster. "She's... she's..." He leaned over the magical staff, panting and scrubbing sand from his eyes. "She's gone."

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (4 of 19)
products.text:
BE IT KNOWN
HIGH SULTAN JAFAR, LORD OF 
LORCANA, HEREBY PROCLAIMS THAT 
THE ILLUMINEER WHO CALLS HERSELF 
"THE OWL" HAS COME TO THE ROYAL 
PALACE OF HER OWN VOLITION FOR HER 
PERSONAL PROTECTION. SHE IS NOW 
ASSISTING HIGH SULTAN JAFAR WITH 
MATTERS OF GREAT CONSEQUENCE. THIS 
CRUCIAL WORK IS NOT TO BE DISTURBED!

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (5 of 19)
products.text:
There are fliers and goons everywhere outside. Jafar says Archazia's working with him, but I doubt it," said Martin. 
"You think?" Shanzay looked around, then grabbed a thought scroll. "She must have something that could help us find her." 
After an hour or two of desperate searching, Venturo whispered excitedly, "I found schematics of the palace! Look!" 
Shanzay looked it over. "Oh yeah, this'll work."

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (6 of 19)
products.text:
As they pored over the schematics, slowly a plan came together. They'd dodge the Jafar glimmer's guards between the library and palace, then sneak in through a tunnel system underneath the building. From there, they could enter the Armory through a hidden hatch and make a break to rescue Archazia from her former workshop. 
As they were leaving, Venturo turned to Martin. "Bring Archazia's inkcaster. She might need it."

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (7 of 19)
products.text:
"Are we sure the tunnels in those schematics are safe?" Martin asked as they dashed to Jafar's palace, the sand wave not far behind them as it continued to sweep over the island. 
"No choice!" Shanzay said. "Look—the entrance is just ahead." 
"Complete with a palace guard." Venturo shaded his eyes. "I bet that's one of Jafar's illusions. See the light patterns shifting?" 
Shanzay blew out a breath. "Okay, so what now?"

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (8 of 19)
products.text:
The guard spotted them and yelled. Martin stepped forward. "Lemme try something..." 
He strummed a few heroic notes on his inkcaster as the sand wave roared ever closer. With the final flourish, a Bolt glimmer took shape. The dog growled at the guard illusion and pierced him with an intense stare. To Venturo's surprise, the guard disappeared in a burst of misty light. 
"Nice work!" Venturo shouted. Grinning, Martin tousled Bolt's white fur.

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (9 of 19)
products.text:
"Guys, there are tiny footprints in the sand here leading away." Martin stopped short at the entrance to the tunnel. "If they're from the Basil glimmer, they might they lead us to Archazia." 
"We don't know that," Shanzay said. "And we can't risk indulging your curiosity again after the Ursula disaster. Come on!" 
Martin glowered but dove in after her just as the sand wave reached them.

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (10 of 19)
products.text:
BE IT KNOWN
UNDER PAIN OF BANISHMENT FROM THE 
KINGDOM, ILLUMINEERS AND GLIMMERS 
ARE COMMANDED TO PRESENT TO HIGH 
SULTAN JAFAR ALL OF THE ILLUMINEER 
ARCHAZIA'S MAGICAL ITEMS OF POWER, 
TO BE KEPT SAFELY IN HIS PALACE.

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (11 of 19)
products.text:
After what seemed like hours in the tunnels, the Illumineers found a room stuffed with treasures. 
“Man, he's greedy,” Venturo said. 
“Maybe,” Shanzay said. “Except he specified Archazia's inventions." Venturo's eyes widened. “Hold on . . .” he said. "Jafar wants to be all-powerful, right? Who's more powerful than Illumineers in Lorcana? Especially Archazia?” He nodded at the Owl's inkcaster in Martin's hands. “I think I know what he's after."

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (12 of 19)
products.text:
Martin didn't hear Venturo—he was staring at the floor. "Look! More tiny tracks! Leading into the maze." 
"No," said Shanzay. "Archazia's workshop is the other way." 
Martin turned to her. "The Basil glimmer has been under Jafar's power for a while, and the whole Island is different now. Following Basil could be more reliable than depending on her schematics." 
Nodding, Venturo said, "Martin has a point." 
Shanzay shrugged. "Fine."

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (13 of 19)
products.text:
Thanks to Basil's footprints, the Illumineers navigated the maze quickly until they came upon the mouse glimmer himself standing in the path looking confused. "Basil!" Martin dropped down. "What are you doing?" 
Basil wrung his tiny hands. "I took a spill and hit my head. The last thing I remember was seeing a rather large owl trapped in an hourglass." Shanzay glanced guiltily at Martin and then answered, "Can you show us?"

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (14 of 19)
products.text:
Basil led them to a nearby room and waved toward the door. "It's through there. I'm still rather unsteady, so I'd best wait here." 
The Illumineers peered through the door. A twenty-foot hourglass dominated the chamber, guarded by an enormous metal scorpion whose tail was half that height. Inside the lower half of the hourglass, surrounded by rising sand, they could make out the green-clad shape of a familiar owl. 
"Archazia!" Shanzay gasped.

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (15 of 19)
products.text:
"We're gonna need backup," Martin said, eyeing the giant scorpion. He strummed his inkcaster. 
A glimmer of Archimedes materialized. "I say, is that my fellow owl enthusiast, Archazia?" 
"Yes." Martin pointed with Archazia's inkcaster. "Distract that while we try to free her!" 
The smaller owl hooted, then zipped around the scorpion. The colossus lumbered in chase, slipping wildly on the marble.

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (16 of 19)
products.text:
The Archimedes glimmer dove, and the scorpion lunged. Its legs sprawled out and its tail crashed into the hourglass, shattering it. Archazia spilled onto the marble in a sandy flood, then rose and sauntered to the Illumineers. 
"Excuse my absence, dears. It seems I've had too much time on my hands." She dusted her feathers and peered at the toppled scorpion. "Leave that for now. We need a plan to stop that Jafar glimmer."

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (17 of 19)
products.text:
Once back in Archazia's library, Shanzay said, "I have an idea." The others gathered around her. "Step one," she began, glancing at Martin with an apologetic smile, "trust our friend's instincts. If we'd followed Basil to begin with, we'd be that much closer to getting out of this mess." 
"Thanks," he said, beaming at her. "And step two?" 
She rubbed her hands together and said with a sly grin, "Trick that Jafar glimmer and retrieve the Hexwell Crown."

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (18 of 19)
products.text:
Archazia wistfully watched their exchange, then closed her eyes. "I never should have let things fester with my friend long ago," she said in a low voice. Squaring her shoulders, she looked at Shanzay. "No matter. How can we trick him long enough to distract from our efforts?" 
Venturo snapped his fingers. "I've got it! We think Jafar's after your inkcaster. He wants to have the power of Illumineers for himself." 
Their mentor chuckled. "Truly! Perhaps we should gift it to him as a peace offering, then. Come, I have a plan."

products.name: Reign of Jafar Lore Card (19 of 19)
products.text:
Archazia held out her inkcaster to the Jasmine glimmer chosen to infiltrate Jafar's palace. "Remember, he thinks this bestows an Illumineer's powers. We know it doesn't, but you must pretend. Distract him while the rest of the team goes for the Hexwell Crown." 
"What if he figures out it won't work for him?" Jasmine asked. 
"Then you'll fight your way out with the Crown. Lorcana is counting on you—Jafar's reign must end."
